meta.name: analyze-feature-requests
meta.description: Analyze and prioritize a list of feature requests by theme, strategic alignment, impact, effort, and risk. Use when reviewing customer feature requests, triaging a backlog, or making prioritization decisions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按主题、影响和风险对功能请求进行排序
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从大量用户反馈中筛选出最值得做的功能
copy.tagline_en: Prioritize feature requests by theme, impact, and risk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to filter the most valuable features from user feedback

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析用户提交的功能请求：先理解你的产品目标，然后把请求按主题归类，评估每个主题的战略匹配度、影响、开发工作量和风险，最后选出最重要的 3 个功能并给出理由、替代方案和测试建议。
howto.when: 当你需要审查用户功能请求、对需求列表排优先级，或做产品决策时，可以触发这个技能。

say.text: 分析这些用户功能请求，帮我排优先级。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤处理你提供的请求列表。

say.text: 我们产品目标是提升用户留存，请评估这些功能请求。
say.note: Claude 会结合你的目标进行战略匹配和优先级排序。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze user feature requests: understand your product goal, categorize requests into themes, evaluate strategic alignment, impact, effort, and risk, then prioritize the top 3 features with rationale, alternatives, and testing suggestions.
howto.when_en: Trigger when reviewing customer feature requests, triaging a backlog, or making prioritization decisions.

say_en.text: Analyze these feature requests and prioritize them.
say_en.note: Claude will process the list step by step.

say_en.text: Our product goal is to improve user retention. Evaluate these requests.
say_en.note: Claude will align with your goal for prioritization.
